title: Sprint deploy pulse — Oct 05–11 2026
content:
Week snapshot (Oct 05–11 2026) — quick pulse for private-deploy installs and open customer blockers.

Attendees: Aditi K (owner), Marc C, Evelyn T, Samir P, field engineers: Jamie L (on-site), Rosa M (remote).

Overview:
- This week focused on three active installs (two VPC, one on-prem air-gapped) plus follow-up for two recent rollbacks.
- Primary themes: last-mile networking oddities, KMS/HSM handshake failures, and a new GPU driver mismatch surfaced by our 8xA100 job.

Highlights / Wins:
- Zenith Health (VPC) back online after MTU mismatch fix at customer's border router — latency regained to SLO. (PD-1287)
- KB automation for initial node-provisioning preflight added to deploy-scripts; reduces manual checklist by ~12 steps. PR merged: deploy-scripts#234.
- On-prem preflight now runs a lightweight NTP/chrony check (added per field feedback) — prevented a potential certificate validation error at one site.

Persistent blockers / New issues:
1) Customer: Argos Systems (on-prem, private datacenter) — intermittent kernel driver oops when loading cudnn with our compiled wheels. Repro steps attached in PD-1293. Hypothesis: vendor-provided driver bundle conflicts with mixed CUDA installs.
   - Impact: install paused; estimated delay 3–5 business days.
   - Owner: Marc C to coordinate vendor support and prepare fallback build (soft-quant builds) by 2026-10-08.
2) Edge ISP NAT / port exhaustion (reported at two VPC installs) causing high tail latency for streaming sessions. This looks environmental — NAT table churn under heavy concurrent streams.
   - Workaround: enable persistent source port hashing + reduce ephemeral port reuse in client pool; field patch tested by Jamie L.
   - Owner: Samir P to roll a change to client side connector and coordinate with CS to test on pilot customers (PD-1310).
3) KMS handshake timeout (HSM-backed keys) — intermittent TLS renegotiation failures when key server load is >90% (seen in remote staging).
   - Next steps: implement exponential backoff + jitter in key-fetch library; Evelyn T to open PR and run load test against HSM simulator.

Operational notes / telemetry:
- Node provisioning: median spin-up time 14m (goal 12m). Majority cost attributed to: OS image download (45%) and Puppet run (30%). Suggestion: switch to delta image layering for net-constrained sites.
- Observed 3 installs with clock skew > 5s which caused cert pinning to fail — added NTP check to preflight.
- Batching/throughput: two VPC installs hit request queue backpressure earlier than expected; investigating cgroup/CRIU defaults on customer's k8s nodes.

Decisions made this week:
- Accept temporary fallback to older GPU driver for Argos until vendor patch validated.
- Standardize the preflight to fail-fast on time sync, MTU mismatch, and required kernel modules — doc updated on Confluence.

Action items (owner — due):
- Marc C — vendor escalation + fallback GPU wheel build for Argos (due 2026-10-08).
- Samir P — client connector patch for ephemeral port handling, coordinate pilot with CS (due 2026-10-11).
- Evelyn T — PR for KMS backoff + HSM load test logs (due 2026-10-09).
- Jamie L — full repro and logs for Argos kernel oops (attach to PD-1293) (due 2026-10-06).
- Rosa M — update hands-off runbook with delta-image notes and NTP preflight checks (due 2026-10-12).

Notes to self / informal:
- Need a short checklist for on-site teams to capture switch model + firmware during site survey — saves hours later. Drafting a two-column form (switch model | MTU defaults | flow-control config).
- Consider shipping a tiny USB stick with our verified kernel modules for constrained sites — avoid rebuilds if vendor drivers blocked. (Thinking out loud)

Open questions / risks:
- If Argos vendor delay extends >7 days, consider offering a temporary hosted fallback until on-prem is stable — need pricing/contract sign-off.
- How many customers are on vendor kernel bundles that prevent us from shipping precompiled wheels? We should run an inventory.

Follow-ups / reminders:
- Standup cadence: keep Tuesday deep-dive for Argos + ISP NAT root cause.
- Sync with CS Thurs 11am to align pilot for connector fix.

Attachments / artifacts to check:
- PD-1287 (Zenith MTU notes) — includes tcpdump capture and border router config diff.
- PD-1293 (Argos reproducible oops logs) — kernel ring buffer and module list.
- PD-1310 (Streaming tail latency investigations) — latency heatmaps + nat-tables snapshot.
- PR: deploy-scripts#234 (node-provisioning automation)

If anything else spikes, ping me in Slack (Aditi K) — I’ll triage and reassign.

— end of pulse —
